diagnosis.finding: Existing pairwise ranking allocates most static utility-gap weight to comparisons that cannot cause a useful intervention.
diagnosis.evidence: Own TRAIN has 158216 qualifying pairs. 90.290079% of their label-gap weight orders two actions both with net gain <= .03; only .810636% directly compares a worthwhile action against keep.
diagnosis.boundary: These are static label weights, not a measurement of active post-fit gradients. Useful negative/keep comparisons remain necessary.

diagnosis.finding: The .05 gross-gap cutoff removes some deployment-relevant winner-versus-keep supervision.
diagnosis.evidence: Own TRAIN: 140 of 1333 beneficial budget-set winners fail the direct keep-pair cutoff; 34 of 350 positive queries have no qualifying winner-versus-keep comparison in any set. VAL: 22/133 sets and 9/45 queries respectively.

diagnosis.finding: The fixed .03 hinge does not require a beneficial action to clear the strict > .03 intervention rule by a calibrated utility margin.
diagnosis.evidence: Source hinge is relu(.03 - predicted_gap), while selection requires best_score > baseline + .03. Gross labels also omit the extra-action .01 bias already in scores.
diagnosis.boundary: This mismatch is not claimed as the sole explanation; two missed VAL cases already have negative gross predicted advantage.

proposed_one_factor.principal_change: Replace only the action-ranking term with a per-budget-set GT winner versus highest predicted legal nonwinner hinge.
proposed_one_factor.fixed: Same own4-prefix/own-future TRAIN902 and VAL128, frozen full GOLA/C1, A/B/C architecture and all other losses including advantage SmoothL1, harm/risk/quality, memory and oracle search auxiliaries; existing disabled write-pair-calibration setting stays disabled. Same seed, epochs, batch, optimizer, validation selection and retained-checkpoint policy. Fixed .03 inference threshold, .01 search charging, action write-verification and one-extra-region budget.
proposed_one_factor.budget_sets: For each query use seven masks: original only, then original plus region r for each r=1..6. Exact action_valid mask; no two distinct extra regions coexist.
proposed_one_factor.target_definition: k = original regular keep. net[a] = U[a]-U[k]-.01*1[region(a)>0]. v[a] = net[a]-.03*1[a!=k], v[k]=0. Let y be the legal argmax net if max net > .03, otherwise explicitly k; this implements keep-on-boundary.
proposed_one_factor.prediction_definition: d[a] = output.scores[a]-.03*1[a!=k]. In the current action-verification configuration scores[k]=0. Do not subtract the .01 extra-region charge again from output.scores.
proposed_one_factor.rival_definition: r is the highest predicted d among legal actions other than y inside that set. Use predicted-score argmax, not loss-augmented argmax and not GT-best rival.
proposed_one_factor.loss: relu((v[y]-v[r]) + d[r]-d[y]); mean over the seven sets, then queries; retain coefficient 1 replacing current ranking_loss.
proposed_one_factor.singleton_definition: Actual data has 5 TRAIN and 1 VAL singleton original-only sets in each arm. Keep the masked rival max VALUE (-inf with no rival), gather only the finite GT rival value, then relu(-inf)=0. Gathering an unmasked rival score after argmax would fabricate a competitor. No fallback or extra branch is necessary.
proposed_one_factor.normalization: Natural per-query/set mean; report intervention-target and keep-target losses separately. No 50:50 class reweighting in the first comparison.
proposed_one_factor.why_minimal: Changes training supervision only; no temperature, new inference gate, architecture, quality rerank, candidate expansion, teacher recollection or extra search.
proposed_one_factor.candidate_comparator: Use the already completed own-future seed42 pairwise run as the matched objective comparator if all other settings match. Old own4 stays the protected best model and a performance reference; it is not the matched causal comparator because its training prefix/cache differ.

required_checks_before_deployment: Source review must confirm only ranking mode/implementation and its trainer plumbing change, with old pairwise branch numerically unchanged.
A legal positive net +.04 action with zero scores must receive gradient that lifts it across strict .03; a no-benefit keep set with a wrongly positive action must push the rival down.
The actual singleton case must produce finite zero loss and zero gradient; masks must exclude invalid actions and incompatible extra regions from both target and rival.
Cost must be present once in scores and once in the GT definition, not subtracted twice from predictions; GT labels remain solely in objective.
A/B/C runtime changes, frozen C1, finite updates and strict reload remain required in existing actual M0.
Only a completed continuous-video comparison can establish progress; cached utility, classification loss or recovered-candidate counts alone are insufficient.

blocking_accuracy_and_leakage_concerns.issue: The five native +2pp targets remain unmet. Current completed future-teacher full98 runs are negative; do not promote either or claim this unrun objective improves accuracy.

GT winner selection or masking must never enter forward/select_actions/search input. No all70-action softmax or target winner across multiple extra regions; each budget target must be formed after its legal mask.
Actual singleton sets need zero loss naturally; unmasked gathered rival scores can create phantom illegal competitors.
Comparing the new objective to old own4 alone confounds objective with prefix/continuation data. Keep current matched teacher/data settings fixed for the objective comparison.

The target uses the existing extra-candidate score bias to match the fixed selector. In actual rollout validation, any triggered search costs .01 even when a local action wins. Do not describe within-set candidate-cost labels as an exact reoptimized sunk-cost search policy or change the validation charging.
The same-family review and all diagnostic decisions are provisional. Reusing held-out development cases for diagnosis makes them development evidence, not a new untouched final test.

no_leakage_found_in_inspected_current_co: Trainer forward passes only DECISION_FIELDS; LABEL_FIELDS include future/GT arrays but are used by objective/evaluation. Search reads region0 candidate summaries plus causal history/motion. Train/VAL names are asserted disjoint. Offline per-set label enumeration does not authorize using unseen extra-region embeddings to choose search online.
boundary_notes: Static pair-weight fractions do not prove optimization causality. Actual own55 detailed query losses remain nonzero (.0106684, .0786117, .0403035), so the old ranking objective is not uniformly blind to these misses.
TRAIN has 15 beneficial exact-tie sets in own and 14 in c1; use the existing deterministic argmax convention and explicit keep-on-threshold policy rather than claiming unique winners everywhere.
The initial coordinate SmoothL1 gradient fractions describe absolute target-coordinate derivatives at zero, not measured shared-parameter training gradients.
